meta.what: EPA UST Finder's underground storage tank facilities per county, and their tanks: open, closed, and temporarily out of service. State records as of 2018-2021; one static value per county.
meta.asOf: state records as of 2018-2021; tribal records to October 2025 (the service's own description)

source.name: EPA UST Finder (Office of Underground Storage Tanks, Office of Research and Development, ASTSWMO)
source.serviceDescription: US EPA's UST Finder data is a national composite of leaking underground storage tanks, underground storage tank facilities, and underground storage tanks as of 2018-2021.  Tribal data is more current with the latest update as of October 2025.

counties.source: TIGERweb https://tigerweb.geo.census.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Generalized_ACS2023/State_County/MapServer layer 13 (Counties 20M: the 50 states, DC and Puerto Rico; Connecticut as planning regions); adjacency from https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/reference/county_adjacency/county_adjacency2023.txt.

meta.join: Each county in counties.json is looked up by state and normalised name among the layer's rows (no FIPS in the layer); a name must match exactly one row and a row serves one county. Checked by point: the county's Census internal point must fall in the polygon of the row its name matched.
meta.zeroRule: Every county has a row, so no 0 is inferred from an absent row. A 0 is the layer's own published 0 (listed in publishedZeros); the composite is only as complete as each state's records, so vector-places may treat a published 0 as observed or mask it.
meta.nullRule: A county with no UST row is null for every feature (nullPlaces, join:no_source_row): Connecticut's nine planning regions (UST Finder has the eight legacy counties) and Alaska's Chugach and Copper River (UST Finder has their predecessor, Valdez-Cordova, listed in unusedSourceRows). A county whose internal point lands in another row's polygon is null (join:name_point_disagree). A field the layer leaves null is null for that county and feature (nullCells, source:null_in_county_layer), never 0; stateWideNulls lists states where it is null for every county, counts.nullCellsByState every state with a null cell, and nullCellNote what the nulls most likely mean.
meta.nullCellNote: Null cells by feature and state: open tanks PR 78, GA 2; closed tanks PR 78, CA 38, GA 2; temporarily out of service PR 78, CA 38, GA 2. Null in every county: PR; in some counties only: CA, GA (which counties: nullCells). Kept null, never 0.
